behavior.budget_semantics: total queue-snapshot provider hint divided across selected issues; provider enforcement unchanged
behavior.environment_error: stop queue before spending on later issues
behavior.no_patch_ready: valid per-issue outcome; continue to next authorized issue
behavior.selection_boundary: open GitHub issues carrying the maintainer-selected label
behavior.unchanged_terminal_issue: skipped until GitHub updatedAt changes unless --retry-unchanged

capability: bounded maintainer-labeled GitHub issue queue that feeds existing Airlock solve without letting the system choose its own work
claim_boundary: Autopilot only selects work from a maintainer-controlled label and sequences existing solve runs. It does not create issues, expand its own mandate, change Starter Rules or protected paths, weaken checks, rank multiple survivors, or turn a failed candidate into a PR.
